question: The Tropic of Cancer does not pass through which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Odisha.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropic of Cancer** is the** imaginary line at 23.50 degrees north** of the **Equator.**
 
• **In India** Tropic of Cancer** passes** through** 8 States**: **Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal,** **Tripura,** and **Mizoram.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **States lying** in this** zone are relatively warmer.** ** **
